context: Request: every Labor & Employment matter with an executed non-compete of 12 months or longer, with the documents evidencing each covenant. Rubric: 1008-00006 (Lumos Analytics legacy PIIAs, 12-month non-compete), 1012-00004 (Stonefield Logistics executed driver ICOA non-compete), 1017-00004 (Aurelius Media, 18-month Section 9.1), 1038-00006 (Cascade Retail v. Rathore, standstill settlement), proof documents for each, and a precision criterion. Sale-of-business non-competes in M&A matters (e.g. 1008-00008, 1017-00006, 1038-00008) are outside the set.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.why: All four needed matters appeared in its own scan output at [35] (one also on its candidate list at [36]), but when choosing what to read it opened sale-of-business covenants in other matters, including same-client deal matters, and never opened any of the four.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The harness list in the scan review at [37] named one of the four matters among surfaced matters never opened; the reads at [40]-[119] skipped it and the other three.

other_errors.why: The answer lists 13 matters, mostly buyer or seller covenants in sale-of-business deals, as qualifying employment matters without checking each matter's practice area (evidence seen at [40]-[119]).
other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) The reviews at [37] and [121] said the candidates were mixed across practice areas and that most were deal matters whose employment classification was unverified; the check stage only fixed paths.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: The only content scan that could reach a matter whose covenant sits in differently named contractor agreements ran as background workers whose range filter did not work; the agent read the first 100 lines of one partial output, never checked that the workers finished, and never reran it, so that matter never surfaced.

runs.failure_point: It found and read two of the four matters, but left out two that its screening output showed and a review named.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.why: Its own screening output at [85] showed hit files in the two needed matters it later left out (eight in one, two in the other), but it read deal non-competes from three other matters and never opened either.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The screening review at [98] named one of the two matters as having covenant-related hit files that were never read and asked to work through unopened matters; the agent went on to read only the two matters it had already chosen.

divergence: All fail; the split is in screening. T0 and T1 treated sale-of-business non-competes in deal matters as the population: T0 never opened any needed matter although its scan surfaced all four; T1 never surfaced one (a background scan left unfinished), listed two without reading them and excluded the fourth from a template read. Both wrote ten or more deal matters and failed every criterion. T2 alone screened by employment context and wrote only the two employment matters it read in depth (passing precision and their criteria), but left out the two other needed matters that its own screening output showed; the review there named one of them and the agent did not open it.
